hypothesis: At model load, KleidiAI repacks every Q8_0 weight (requantisation to per-row int8 plus kai_run_rhs_pack_nxk_qsi8cxp_qsi8cx_neon) one tensor at a time on the loading thread, while 5 of the function's 6 vCPUs sit idle (the download has already finished). Splitting each tensor's repack into 6 nr-aligned row blocks on 6 threads cuts cold model_load_mmap from about 8.4 s to about 3-4 s (the repack is about 6 s of it; the rest is serial), with bytewise-identical packed weights and therefore bit-identical answers. Restore and warm should not change: the SnapStart snapshot is taken after the load. Reported either way.

changed_variable.name: threads running the KleidiAI weight repack at model load
changed_variable.baseline: 1: upstream's serial loops (P1's libraries in base; the patched libraries with GGML_KLEIDIAI_REPACK_THREADS unset in off, whose serial loops are upstream's text)
changed_variable.experiment: par: GGML_KLEIDIAI_REPACK_THREADS=6 (the vCPU count at 10,240 MB). Same zip as off, same configuration, same weights object; the packing routine and the packed bytes are unchanged

Six repack threads cut cold model_load_mmap on CPU part 0xd40 from {effect_cold_model_load_mmap_0xd40_a:.2f} s to {effect_cold_model_load_mmap_0xd40_b:.2f} s, and the cold first request (Init + Duration) from {effect_cold_first_request_total_0xd40_a:.2f} s to {effect_cold_first_request_total_0xd40_b:.2f} s (delta {effect_cold_first_request_total_0xd40_d:+.2f} s, 95% CI [{effect_cold_first_request_total_0xd40_lo:+.2f}, {effect_cold_first_request_total_0xd40_hi:+.2f}], n {effect_cold_first_request_total_0xd40_n}). Same sign in every round on every CPU part: 0xd0c {effect_cold_first_request_total_0xd0c_d:+.2f} s (n {effect_cold_first_request_total_0xd0c_n}), 0xd4f {effect_cold_first_request_total_0xd4f_d:+.2f} s (n {effect_cold_first_request_total_0xd4f_n}); those two strata are small. The load-phase part of the hypothesis (8.4 s to 3-4 s) held, and the result is below its range. Restore and warm do not change: restore first request {effect_restore_first_request_total_0xd40_d:+.3f} s [{effect_restore_first_request_total_0xd40_lo:+.3f}, {effect_restore_first_request_total_0xd40_hi:+.3f}], warm {effect_warm_steady_state_inference_0xd40_d:+.3f} s [{effect_warm_steady_state_inference_0xd40_lo:+.3f}, {effect_warm_steady_state_inference_0xd40_hi:+.3f}] on 0xd40. Max Memory Used unchanged. Init Duration unchanged ({effect_cold_report_init_duration_0xd40_d:+.3f} s), because the on-demand load runs in PR #77's background thread after Init. The SnapStart snapshot init also loads faster, so publish_version is shorter, but restores replay the snapshot either way. Correctness: 1,800/1,800 answers bit-identical to P1's reference; all 320 loaded tensors (187 KleidiAI-packed, 1.89 GB) hash-identical to P1's libraries at 1, 2, 3 and 6 threads, offline. With the switch unset, the patched libraries match P1's on every headline stratum with n >= 5 per arm. Cost $3.53 at list prices. Host: three CPU parts observed (0xd40, 0xd0c, 0xd4f), split above; no generation is inferred from them.
